Class BroadphaseSpatialHash

Namespace
ShapeEngine.Geometry.CollisionSystem
Assembly
ShapeEngine.dll

Implements a spatial hash grid for efficient broad-phase collision detection and spatial queries.

public class BroadphaseSpatialHash : IBroadphase, IBounds

Remarks

The spatial hash divides a 2D space into a grid of buckets, each containing colliders that overlap its region. Provides fast lookup for collision candidates and supports dynamic resizing and grid changes.

Constructors

BroadphaseSpatialHash(Rect, Size)

Initializes a new instance of the BroadphaseSpatialHash class using the provided bounding rectangle and a desired bucket size. The grid's column and row counts are computed by dividing the bounds' dimensions by bucketSize and rounding up so the grid fully covers the bounds.

public BroadphaseSpatialHash(Rect bounds, Size bucketSize)

Parameters

bounds Rect

The bounding rectangle for the grid.

bucketSize Size

The desired width and height of each bucket cell.

Remarks

The values of SpacingX and SpacingY are derived from the resolved Rows and Cols (rather than being set directly from bucketSize). This ensures the grid cells evenly partition the provided bounds and that the grid fully covers it even when the bounds' dimensions are not exact multiples of the requested bucket size.

Initializes a new instance of the BroadphaseSpatialHash class using the provided bounding rectangle and a desired bucket cell width and height.

public BroadphaseSpatialHash(Rect bounds, float bucketWidth, float bucketHeight)

Parameters

bounds Rect

The bounding rectangle that the grid must cover.

bucketWidth float

Desired width for each bucket cell. The actual cell width is computed so cells evenly partition bounds.

bucketHeight float

Desired height for each bucket cell. The actual cell height is computed so cells evenly partition bounds.

Remarks

The values of SpacingX and SpacingY are derived from the resolved Rows and Cols (rather than being set directly from bucketWidth/bucketHeight). This ensures the grid cells evenly partition the provided bounds and that the grid fully covers it even when the bounds' dimensions are not exact multiples of the requested bucket size.

BroadphaseSpatialHash(float, float, float, float, float, float)

Initializes a new instance of the BroadphaseSpatialHash class using explicit bounds defined by (x, y, w, h) and a desired bucket cell width and height.

public BroadphaseSpatialHash(float x, float y, float w, float h, float bucketWidth, float bucketHeight)

Parameters

x float

The X coordinate of the grid's top-left corner.

y float

The Y coordinate of the grid's top-left corner.

w float

The width of the grid bounds.

h float

The height of the grid bounds.

bucketWidth float

Desired width for each bucket cell. The actual number of columns is computed as Ceiling(w / bucketWidth) so the grid fully covers the bounds.

bucketHeight float

Desired height for each bucket cell. The actual number of rows is computed as Ceiling(h / bucketHeight) so the grid fully covers the bounds.

Remarks

The values of SpacingX and SpacingY are derived from the computed Rows and Cols to evenly partition the provided bounds.

ChangeGrid(int, int)

Changes the number of rows and columns in the grid. This operation clears all buckets.

public void ChangeGrid(int rows, int cols)

Parameters

rows int

The new number of rows.

cols int

The new number of columns.

Remarks

Recalculates spacing, clears and removes all old buckets, and then creates new buckets according to rows*cols.

GetCandidateBucketsThreadSafe(Collider, ref List<BroadphaseBucket>)

Thread-safe retrieval of candidate buckets that may contain colliders overlapping the given collider.

public int GetCandidateBucketsThreadSafe(Collider collider, ref List<BroadphaseBucket> candidateBuckets)

Parameters

collider Collider

The collider to query. Disabled colliders are ignored.

candidateBuckets List<BroadphaseBucket>

A list to populate with candidate buckets that may contain overlapping colliders.

Returns

int

The number of buckets added to candidateBuckets.

Remarks

Uses a thread-local temporary HashSet<T> to collect cell IDs and avoid per-call allocations. If the collider already has cached bucket ids in the register, those are used directly.
